title: n8n Automation Engineer
description:
**Location:** Remote / Hybrid

**Experience:** 3 to 5 Years

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**About the Role**

We are seeking an experienced **n8n Automation Engineer** with **3–5 years of experience** to build and maintain high-volume automated workflows and WhatsApp Business API integrations. You will connect core systems (CRMs, databases, APIs) to dynamic messaging flows and chatbots.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **n8n Workflow Development:** Build, test, and optimize complex workflows in n8n (custom JS nodes, error handling, sub-workflows).
* **WhatsApp Automation:** Design interactive message flows, button menus, template triggers, and bot logic using Meta Cloud API or BSPs (Twilio, 360dialog, Wati).
* **API & System Integrations:** Connect n8n via REST/GraphQL APIs and webhooks to CRMs (HubSpot, Zoho, GHL), databases (PostgreSQL, Supabase), and payment gateways.
* **Data & Performance:** Handle JSON data transformations, rate limits, error logging, and pipeline uptime.

**Requirements**

* **3–5 years** in automation, software integration, or backend development.
* **2+ years** of direct, hands-on production experience with **n8n**.
* Strong understanding of **WhatsApp Business API** architecture and Meta policies.
* Solid skills in **JavaScript / Node.js** (for n8n function nodes) and **REST APIs / Webhooks**.
* Experience with SQL/NoSQL databases.

**Nice to Have**

* Self-hosting n8n setup (Docker, VPS, Nginx).
* AI/LLM integration experience (OpenAI, Claude) within n8n workflows.

**To Apply:** Send your resume and brief details of past n8n/WhatsApp projects to careers@knowtifics.com

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu 641004

title: Process Automation Engineer
description:
As a **Process Automation Engineer**, you'll develop and maintain production-ready automations using platforms like n8n, integrate systems, and support AI-driven solutions that improve business efficiency. Build your career with Emapta, where top 1% talent gains international exposure, long-term growth, and a professional environment that values expertise and innovation.

**Job Overview**

* Employment Type: Full-time
* Shift: Day Shift, Weekends Off
* Work Setup: Hybrid, Meena Gateway, India

**Exciting Perks Await!**

* Competitive package
* Medical life insurance
* Work from home arrangement
* Standard government and Emapta benefits
* Well-equipped, modern, and accessible offices
* Employee engagement initiatives
* Mentorship and exposure to global leaders and teamsDiverse, inclusive, and supportive culture
* Transparent performance management
* Unlimited upskilling through Emapta Academy courses (Want to know more? Visit: https://emapta.com/training-calendar/)

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

Educational Background

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Professional Experience

* At least 3 years of experience in workflow automation or systems integration, with proven production experience using n8n, Make, Zapier, Power Automate, or similar platforms.
* Hands-on experience in API integration, data transformation, error handling, and authentication within automated workflows.
* Exposure to AI-assisted automation, including Large Language Model (LLM) API calls and document processing, is a strong advantage.

Required Technical Skills

* Strong proficiency in n8n or equivalent automation platforms, including complex workflow branching, error handling, and sub-workflow development.
* Practical scripting skills in JavaScript or Python for custom workflow steps and data manipulation.
* Solid understanding of engineering best practices, including technical documentation, software testing, and version control.
* Effective communication skills for collaboration with business analysts, process specialists, and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with LLM APIs and prompt-driven automation workflows.
* Familiarity with databases, webhooks, and common Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) ecosystems, including Customer Relationship Management (CRM), IT Service Management (ITSM), and Human Resources Information Systems (HRIS).
* Relevant certifications in workflow automation platforms.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

Automation Design & Development

* Design and develop workflow automations and system integrations using n8n and related platforms, from documented process requirements to fully tested, production-ready solutions.
* Incorporate AI components, including Large Language Model (LLM) workflows, document intelligence, and agentic automation patterns, in accordance with the AI Tech Lead's technical designs and standards.
* Apply established engineering standards for version control, software testing, error management, system logs, technical documentation, and secure credential management.

Deployment & Support

* Deploy workflow automations across client and internal environments to meet operational requirements and improve business efficiency.
* Monitor automation performance, resolve technical defects, and stabilize deployed solutions to ensure reliability and continuity.
* Develop and maintain runbooks and operational documentation to support long-term system maintenance and effective technical support.

Requirements & Collaboration

* Collaborate with process specialists and client subject matter experts to validate requirements, identify edge cases, and define exception-handling procedures before development.
* Provide technical recommendations and effort estimates to support solution design, project scope, and implementation plans.

Capability Growth

* Follow the team's structured technical development plan to expand expertise in workflow automation, software development, AI engineering patterns, and additional automation platforms.
* Develop and contribute reusable automation components, templates, and technical patterns to the team's shared asset library.

Discovery & Solution Design Support

* Develop feasibility prototypes and proof-of-concept automations during project discovery and business development phases.
* Assess technical feasibility, estimate development effort, and provide technical insights for proposed automation projects.

Other Responsibilities

* Perform additional duties as assigned by authorized company representatives through written instructions or verbal assignments.

Project Scope

* Develop, implement, and support workflow automations across assigned client projects and internal efficiency initiatives, with responsibility for multiple concurrent workstreams.

Business Impact

* Deliver reliable, scalable, and maintainable automation solutions that improve operational efficiency and maximize business value.
* Minimize technical risks, workflow failures, and operational disruptions through disciplined engineering practices and consistent solution quality.

Decision-Making Authority

* Make implementation decisions within approved technical designs, project requirements, and engineering standards.
* Escalate proposed design changes, scope concerns, technical blockers, and implementation risks to the AI Tech Lead.

Pay: ₹150,000.00 - ₹200,000.00 per month

* Are you proficient in n8n or equivalent automation platforms, including complex workflow branching, error handling, and sub-workflow development?
* Are you willing to work Hybrid (Meena Gateway, Coimbatore Tamil Nadu) for this role?

Experience:

* workflow automation or systems integration: 3 years (Required)
* JavaScript or Python: 5 years (Required)

title: SDET QA Engineer
description:
**SDET QA Engineer**

**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience:** 2–5 Years  
**Location:** Coimbatore  
**Annual CTC:** ₹ 6 to 7 LPA  
**Job Summary**  
We are looking for a motivated SDET QA Engineer to ensure the quality and reliability of our web applications through automation testing. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in UI and API test automation, CI/CD pipelines, cloud-based environments, and modern JavaScript/TypeScript development practices.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, maintain, and execute automated test suites for React-based web applications.
* Design and perform API testing for REST services.
* Build and maintain test automation frameworks using Playwright (preferred) or Cypress.
* Create and maintain automated regression and end-to-end test suites.
* Collaborate with developers to identify, track, and resolve defects.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
* Perform functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing.
* Participate in code reviews and follow Git best practices.
* Validate applications deployed on AWS and Heroku environments.
* Support testing of Node.js backend services and APIs.
* Contribute to improving test coverage, quality metrics, and release processes.

**Required Skills**

* Minimum 2 years of experience in QA Automation or SDET roles.
* Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript.
* Hands-on experience with Playwright (preferred) or Cypress.
* Experience in REST API testing using tools such as Postman or automated API test frameworks.
* Experience testing React web applications.
* Understanding of CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, etc.).
* Experience working with AWS cloud services.
* Knowledge of Git workflows and pull request/code review practices.
* Familiarity with Node.js applications and backend testing.
* Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
* Experience with SQL databases and data validation.
* Knowledge of test reporting and test management tools.
* Experience with Heroku deployments.
* Understanding of modern testing and quality engineering best practices.

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹58,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
